# Cerix Global

> Cerix Global provides elite cross-border corporate structuring, company setup, licensing, and wealth advisory services across tier-one international financial hubs.

## Core Services
- Cross-Border Corporate Structuring: Establishing multi-jurisdictional corporate entities for asset protection and tax efficiency.
- Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) Administration: Setting up and managing funds in Mauritius and the Cayman Islands.
- Global Licensing & Compliance: Regulatory navigation for financial services firms.
